items.title: Is FactSet’s Expanded Credit Facilities Reshaping the Investment Case For FactSet Research Systems (FDS)?

By removing amortization on the term loan and eliminating certain credit spread adjustments, the revised agreement meaningfully increases FactSet’s financial flexibility and access to liquidity for future corporate needs.
